evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched 'A rollback … is a rollback …' frame sets rehearsed-vs-unrehearsed in deliberate opposition — parallel antithesis doing argumentative work.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Does the expression crystallize a rule by restating its subject in matched opposed clauses — unrehearsed equals unowned?
